title: The Final Race! (P5)
description: Deploying a unified autonomy stack to navigate an aggressive obstacle course comprising strictly known and dynamically unknown geometric windows.

stats.label: Sprint Time
stats.detail: simulation time for a complete round-trip sprint through known and unknown gates

extraText: Multi-Model Perception Switching: Seamlessly toggles between rigorous Convolutional object detection tracking for standard gates and dense optical/depth active sensing (using RAFT and U-Net) for dynamically generated window shapes.
Global to Local Spline Morphing: The hierarchical RRT* navigation stack morphs global targets with local perception updates, letting the quadrotor arc smoothly through gates without decelerating.

Round-Trip Sprint Navigation: Dynamically pivots to execute a mirrored tracking pass backward through the entire obstacle flow, requiring complete spatial awareness and robust PID altitude hold under significant velocity perturbations.
